:::{#exr-bias-sq-plus-var}
#### Squared bias plus variance

Using @exr-sq-bias-expand,
write $\sqf{\bias{\hparam}} + \var{\hparam}$
in terms of $\E{\hparam^2}$, $\E{\hparam}$, and the estimand $\param$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bias-sq-plus-var}

The variance is
([simplified expression for variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#thm-variance)):

$$\var{\hparam} = \E{\hparam^2} - \sqf{\E{\hparam}}$$

Add it to the squared bias from @exr-sq-bias-expand and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqf{\bias{\hparam}} + \var{\hparam}
&= \sqf{\E{\hparam}} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2 + \var{\hparam}
&& \text{(substitute the squared bias)}\\
&= \sqf{\E{\hparam}} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2 + \E{\hparam^2} - \sqf{\E{\hparam}}
&& \text{(substitute the variance)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2 + \sqf{\E{\hparam}} - \sqf{\E{\hparam}}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2 + \paren{\sqf{\E{\hparam}} - \sqf{\E{\hparam}}}
&& \text{(group the last two terms)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2 + 0
&& \text{($a - a = 0$)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
